title: Opening Theme
theme: The first thirty seconds of the arc. Someone is running toward a thing they have not named yet, and the sky opens above them. A story starts, and the song is the shape of starting. Triumphant and urgent at once: the joy carries the ache, not the other way around.

notes: Lane fit: streaming, sync, direct-license, youtube-gaming. Shape single-4min: this is a SHOWPIECE, not a loop, and it must survive a 90-second TV cut with the arc intact (hook -> verse -> pre-chorus -> chorus -> bridge -> final chorus). Tempo 130-180 BPM, J-rock pocket 160-170 (160 pinned here); below 130 drifts to pop-rock, above 180 to speed-metal. The busy double-kick pattern and the eighth-note melodic bass are the engine; strings AND piano over rhythm guitars with synth pads underneath is the post-2010s anison wall of sound. Stems are mandatory for the sync and direct-license lanes. Lyrics are human-authored — queue the plan with lyricsMode draft and let j_kro write and claim the sheet; AI-written lyrics void the copyright claim this pipeline registers. Consumed by the Virtual Reflections album, tracks 7-8 ("Opening Theme", "Becoming"). One open flag: the youtube-gaming lane renders loop-10min while this genre's shape is single-4min, so that lane needs a second render or it stays unreached.
